name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-breach
description: See where your data has leaked: search your own email for free, put each breach on a timeline with what to do, and get told about new ones. A password is tested without being sent. No breach file is ever downloaded.

descriptionI18n.en: See where your data has leaked: search your own email for free, put each breach on a timeline with what to do, and get told about new ones. A password is tested without being sent. No breach file is ever downloaded.
descriptionI18n.fr: Vois où tes données ont fuité : cherche ton propre email gratuitement, pose chaque fuite sur une frise avec quoi faire, et sois prévenu des nouvelles. Un mot de passe est testé sans être envoyé. Aucun fichier de fuite n'est jamais téléchargé.
descriptionI18n.es: Mira dónde se han filtrado tus datos: busca tu propio correo gratis, pon cada filtración en una línea de tiempo con qué hacer y entérate de las nuevas. Una contraseña se comprueba sin enviarla. Nunca se descarga ningún archivo de filtración.

agentGuide: Name a breach the way the person says it (« Adobe », « la fuite LinkedIn », « linkedin.com »): MnemoBreach finds it by its words. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.
To read: breaches for the person's timeline and what is left to do, catalogue for the public list, news for what is new.

Steps after a breach: password (changed the password), twoFactor (two-step login), phishing (watch for phishing mails), calls (scam calls), mail (postal mail), antivirus, allPasswords (changed every password). « J'ai tout fait » for one breach: markHandled.
« J'avais un compte chez X »: declare. Searching the person's email, testing a password and turning the watch on stay the person's own gestures.

agentActions.summary: The breaches on the person's timeline: service, date, what leaked, found by a search or declared, and which protective steps are done or still to do.
agentActions.details: Emails are masked as on screen. exposedDays runs from the breach to the first step taken, or to today. A breach with no known date has no exposedDays.

agentActions.summary: Search the public list of known breaches (Have I Been Pwned) by service name or domain.
agentActions.details: Free and public; no identifier of the person is sent. onTimeline says whether it is already on the person's timeline.

query.description: Words of the service name or domain; empty = the most recent.

agentActions.summary: Put a breach from the public list on the person's timeline ("I had an account there"), as the Declare button does.

name.description: The breach as the person says it (« Adobe », « la fuite LinkedIn », « linkedin.com ») or its name from catalogue.

agentActions.summary: Take a declared breach off the timeline. One found by a search of the person's email stays.

name.description: The breach as the person says it (« Adobe », « la fuite LinkedIn », « linkedin.com ») or its name from breaches.

agentActions.summary: Mark a protective step as done (or not) for one breach: changed password, 2FA, watch for phishing, scam calls, mail, antivirus, all passwords.
agentActions.details: Only the steps listed for that breach in breaches apply (NOT_APPLICABLE otherwise). Calling it twice does not flip it back.

name.description: The breach as the person says it (« Adobe », « la fuite LinkedIn », « linkedin.com ») or its name from breaches.

agentActions.summary: Mark every protective step of one breach as done (« c'est réglé pour Adobe »), as ticking each of its boxes does.
agentActions.details: Only the steps that apply to that breach. A breach already handled stays as it is.

name.description: The breach as the person says it (« Adobe », « la fuite LinkedIn », « linkedin.com ») or its name from breaches.

agentActions.summary: The breaches made public since the person last marked the news as seen: the ones on a service of the timeline first, then a count of the others.
agentActions.details: first = no memory yet (the first visit): nothing is announced. watchOn says whether the background watch runs.

agentActions.summary: Mark the news as seen, as the card's « mark as seen » does: the next news starts from now.
Turn off the background watch of the timeline's services, as the card's « turn off » does.
agentActions.details: Turning it on stays a gesture of the person: the card says first what it sends.
